title: SIDESTORY: HEART OF SURGING FLAME - RERUN OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: HEART OF SURGING FLAME RERUN
EVENT DURATION: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 3, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: Heart of Surging Flame event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the Milestone Missions, and redeeming from event shop.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
[Main Stage]: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 30, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Fairgrounds]: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 30, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Extra Show]: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 30, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
EVENT STAGES CONSUME:
[Main Stage]: Consumes Sanity
[Fairgrounds]: Consumes Obsidian Festival Ticket
[Extra Show]: Consumes Sanity
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP:
[Main Stage]: Siesta Obsidian, Obsidian Festival Ticket
[Fairgrounds]: Obsidian Festival Token
*Players who clear the event stage OF-4 for the first time can obtain the event Operator ★★★★★: Ceylon
NOTE:
During this rerun event, the stage progress from its first release will be kept
and the first-clear reward will not be reset
During this rerun event, some rewards that cannot be obtained repeatedly
will be converted into Intelligence Certificate in corresponding conversion
Please check the Intelligence Certificate Converting Rules in the event
for more details
Converted Intelligence Certificate can be used to exchange in Certificate Store
Thorns, Andreana, Jaye, Schwarz, Ceylon, Glaucus and Sussurro will gain more trust within this event
02 CAPSULE MACHINES OPEN
EVENT DURATION: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 3, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Obsidian Festival Token by clearing event stages. Obsidian Festival Token can be used to draw rewards from Capsule Machines.
MAIN REWARDS: Ceylon's Token, Event Furniture (pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Record, Elite Materials, etc.
03 COLLECTING SIESTA OBSIDIAN TO REDEEM LIMITED REWARDS
EVENT DURATION: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 3, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can collect Siesta Obsidian to complete the Milestone Missions. When Siesta Obsidian reaches a certain number, players can obtain corresponding rewards.
MAIN REWARDS:
Coral Coast Collection - Casual Vacation HDm06 for Ansel
Obsidian Festival Ticket, Obsidian Festival Token, Event Furniture (pieces), Battle Record, Elite Materials, etc.
04 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – UNBOUND REFLUX
DURATION: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 10, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Unbound Reflux", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Thorns
★★★★★: Andreana / Provence
★★★★: Jaye
05 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting “Unbound Reflux”, and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
★★★★★★: Thorns
★★★★★: Andreana
★★★★: Jaye
NOTE: Operator Ceylon is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Heart of Surging Flame. Operator Ceylon is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
06 CORAL COAST COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 3, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection - Silent Night DN02 for Shining
Coral Coast Collection - Temperature Difference RT.RX01 for Skyfire
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA011 for Gummy
07 CORAL COAST COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 10, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection - Waverider WR04 for Skadi
Coral Coast Collection - Shimmering Dew SD05 for Platinum
Coral Coast Collection - Casual Vacation HD08 for Provence
08 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET - RHODES ISLAND MODERN MUSIC REHEARSAL ROOM
DURATION: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 3, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Event stage 3-star first clear reward (Pieces)
Milestone Mission rewards (Pieces)
Capsule Machine (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
Part of this furniture set will be available at the Store from January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 3, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
09 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET - SIESTA BEACH HUT
DURATION: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 3, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Part of this furniture set will be available at the Store from January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 3, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
10 RE-EDITION - HEART OF SURGING FLAME ARTIST FURNITURE
DURATION: January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 17, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: These limited furniture will be available at the Store from January 20, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 17, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
